Obviously this isn't a foolproof way of knowing if a host is vulnerable (See Security disclaimer in README.md), but it's at least good at finding hosts in your environment that are advertising to the internet that they are using a vulnerable version of PHP. show_hn.story_text: KronLSTM launched!
